visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with vibrant purple hair and a yellow racing jacket stands in a nighttime urban street. She looks pensive, clutching the lapels of her jacket. Below her, a split-screen displays a CGI avatar with the same hair mirroring her pose in a dark, ethereal green environment. (2) The woman runs across a city street, her long purple braid swinging behind her. The animation below shows the character running through a misty forest. Neon signs and city traffic are visible in the background of the top frame. (3) The woman leans her forehead against a glass window in a moment of despair. The avatar below mimics this against a wall of leaves. Suddenly, the scene shifts to a group of men gathered around a laptop and phone, laughing as they watch the content. (4) The woman is now seated, looking down with a sad expression. In the lower frame, the avatar sits on an ornate dragon-themed throne under a bright spotlight. She then looks up with intense eyes, and the avatar is shown on a stage with a dramatic golden cape. (5) A second woman with blue hair in buns appears in a teal top. She smiles and sings towards the camera while the animation below mirrors her. She performs dance movements and spins in the middle of a crowded urban square at night. (6) A third woman with long pink hair sits on a railing in front of a large digital billboard. The avatar below sits in a chair surrounded by male figures in suits. The woman kicks her leg up high, and the avatar follows the action perfectly. (7) All three women stand together in the street, striking a confident pose. The animation below shows the three avatars in a similar formation. The final shot is a CGI golden airplane flying toward a bright orange and purple sunset.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 3 main female creators, a group of 6 men watching a screen, and several pedestrians in the background of the urban scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Three women: one with purple hair in a yellow racing jacket, one with blue hair buns in a teal top, and one with pink hair in a black crop top and yellow skirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A busy night street in Taipei (Ximending) with neon signs, digital billboards, and traffic. The animated sections feature a misty forest, a throne room, and a sunset sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A breathy female vocal begins over a mid-tempo electronic pop beat. The BGM features clean synth pads and a driving 4/4 percussion kick. There is a faint sound of fabric rustling as the speaker moves. (2) A sharp, rhythmic sigh is heard at 0:02, signaling a transition. The vocal pitch rises as the singer enters a more melodic, projected phrase. The BGM maintains a steady, high-energy pulse. (3) A sudden burst of male laughter and background chatter occurs at 0:06, creating a layer of diegetic noise that suggests an audience watching a video. The music continues in the background. (4) The vocal resumes with high arousal and power, singing about being a queen. The BGM swells with a brighter spectral profile and more complex harmonic layers. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the introduction of a new visual phase. The vocal remains energetic and enunciated, with a high speech rate matching the dance rhythm. (6) Heavy percussive hits are added to the BGM mix, increasing the beat strength. The female voice maintains a dominant and confident tone throughout the second half of the track. (7) The music reaches a climactic peak with layers of synthesized strings and electronic textures. The vocal ends on a sustained high note before a clean fade-out of the electronic tail.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Conflict/Sorrow -> Transformation -> Empowerment -> Finale
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a creative showcase of real-life cosplay mirrored by CGI animation. It uses a high-energy pop song to narrate a story of personal growth and confidence, transitioning from lonely, sad scenes in the city to powerful, unified performances by a trio of women and their digital counterparts. It highlights the technical synergy between live filming and 3D character animation.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The split-screen execution is highly precise, showing a direct frame-for-frame synchronization between human movement and CGI rigging.
